status: H03 motorless station concept; cam geometry and latch travel modeled, force and hardware qualification open

module_pitch.description: Separation of the two demonstration modules

profile_allowance.description: Offset allowance between analytic roller envelope and faceted cam profile

closing_take_up.description: Initial gap between closing follower and collar input pad

bolt_travel.description: Latch pull stroke before quarter turn

latch.release_instruction: Support the tube with the raised pusher at 210 deg, pull 4.5 mm, quarter-turn 90 deg to hold open, then reverse the main cam to lower and open; rearm after the tube is seated

robot_inputs: latch pull and quarter turn for reset
handoff_sequence: Turn 0–30 deg to approach the external tube bottom
Turn 30–130 deg to lift the tube
Turn 130–200 deg to raise the wedge collar and close both receiver halves
Allow the spring bolt to enter during the 200–210 deg dwell
Pause at 220 deg and independently verify tube capture and bolt engagement
After confirmation turn to 360 deg to retract station followers; the bolt holds the collar closed
Use the robot to remove the latched receiver
For reset return receiver, reverse to 210 deg under pusher support, pull and quarter-turn the latch, then reverse the main cam to zero

passive_bias_requirements.jaw_opening: Two outward bias springs required; geometry/ratings not selected
passive_bias_requirements.collar_return: Gravity-assisted descent; friction and need for a return spring must be tested
passive_bias_requirements.bolt_closing: Compression spring in the modeled barrel cavity; rating and preload are null
passive_bias_requirements.cam_followers: Gravity-assisted return; preload/contact at operating speed unqualified

limitations: No station motors are modeled; the robot supplies the main turn, receiver transport and latch release
The source defines the nominal cycle and explicit latch state; springs, gravity and unilateral contact are not dynamically simulated
Both native SolidCraft cam followers use geometric joint.cam links; latch state and wedge closure use source-derived input expressions
Faceted roller-envelope profiles include a 0.03 mm modeling allowance, not a manufactured cam tolerance
Latch spring cavity and bearing clearances are modeled; no spring, bearing, force limit or robot torque is qualified
Pause at 220 deg and confirm actual tube capture and latch insertion before returning the pusher
A pull-and-quarter-turn release is a separate robot action for reset; it is not another station motor
Tube and optical references remain H02 concept geometry; lids and full robot paths are outside this model
